info.title: Sitometron External REST v1
info.description:
The External REST v1 Job surface. Accepted ADR-0008 and Accepted ADR-0009 are the authority; where this document and an ADR differ, this document is wrong (ADR-0008 Section 8).

Rules this document cannot express, and where they are decided:

- Transport: HTTP/1.1 on a loopback address only, no TLS and no authentication in v1; every local process that can reach the listener is trusted as the operator (ADR-0008 Section 1). HTTP message syntax is RFC 9112's; `HTTP/1.0` requests and absolute-form targets are answered, and `OPTIONS *` and authority-form targets are `404` `route_not_found` (ADR-0009 Section 1).
- Compatibility: within `/v1` only additions are made. Clients ignore unknown response fields and classify an unknown error `code` by its status. The `state` and `outcome` vocabularies are closed (ADR-0008 Section 2).
- Check order: refusals before routing (ADR-0009 Section 1), then route, method, media type, size, the body receive timeout, JSON, validation, the writer's ingress result (`service_failed`, `not_ready`, `capacity_exhausted`, `busy`), then the ADR-0002 result. The first matching condition decides (ADR-0008 Section 5, ADR-0009 Section 2).
- Queries: v1 defines no query parameter; a target with a query is `404` `route_not_found` (ADR-0009 Section 4).
- Bodies: the body rows of ADR-0008 Section 5 apply to any request that has a body, including an operation that defines none: `415` without `Content-Type: application/json`, `413`, `408` while it is received, `400` `malformed_json`, and `422` `validation_failed` for well-formed JSON, since such an operation expects no body (ADR-0008 Section 5, ADR-0009 Section 2). A request without a body has no media type to check (ADR-0009 Section 5).
- Strict JSON: a raw NUL, invalid UTF-8, data after the value, or a duplicate key at any depth is `malformed_json` (ADR-0009 Section 8).
- Errors: every error status uses `ErrorEnvelope`, except the `503` of `GET /v1/ready`. `details` is `{}` in v1. Messages never contain a file-system path, a raw operating-system or library error, a Journal record, or a secret (ADR-0008 Section 5, ADR-0009 Section 7).
- State: every Job value reflects only events committed in the JobJournal; `terminal` can be `true` before exit confirmation, release, and cleanup are recorded (ADR-0008 Section 3, ADR-0009 Section 11).
- Nothing waits: no request blocks on capacity, on another Job, or on a Job reaching a state (ADR-0008 Section 7).

servers.description: The loopback listener; the address and port are startup configuration (an IPv6 loopback address is equally valid).

/v1/jobs.description: Every method other than GET, POST is answered `405` `request`/`method_not_allowed` with an `Allow: GET, POST` header (ADR-0008 Section 5, ADR-0009 Section 6); see the response `MethodNotAllowed` in `components`.

post.description: Creates a Job for a registered Application. Answers `202` only after `job_created` is committed; the Job is at least `admitted`. Never waits for capacity: it admits now or refuses. The client cannot choose a `job_id` and there is no idempotency key; a client that loses the response lists the Jobs (ADR-0008 Section 4). Creation is serialized by the adapter; a creation that meets `already_pending` anyway is `503` `busy` (ADR-0009 Section 3). A request without a body is `400` `malformed_json` (ADR-0009 Section 5).

/v1/jobs/{job_id}/cancel.description: Every method other than POST is answered `405` `request`/`method_not_allowed` with an `Allow: POST` header (ADR-0008 Section 5, ADR-0009 Section 6); see the response `MethodNotAllowed` in `components`.

post.description: Submits the ADR-0002 `cancel` command with the principal from the daemon's startup configuration; no request field or header supplies it (ADR-0008 Section 4). `202` means the cancel is recorded, not that the Job has stopped. The Job in the `202` is read after `cancel_accepted` and can be `stopping`, `finalizing`, or terminal (ADR-0009 Section 11). A repeated cancel never records a second cancel. A cancel is a normal ingress input: while admission is closed it is `503` `not_ready`, including for the unresolved Job that keeps admission closed (ADR-0008 Section 6, ADR-0009 Section 11). `terminate` has no endpoint in v1.

- `request`/`validation_failed`: Well-formed JSON that is not the expected object; an operation that defines no request body expects none (ADR-0008 Section 5, ADR-0009 Sections 9 and 10).

validation_failed.summary: Well-formed JSON that is not the expected object; an operation that defines no request body expects none

error.message: Text for people; not part of the contract.

431.description:
Request Header Fields Too Large. Error codes:

- `request`/`headers_too_large`: The header section exceeds the listener's header bound (ADR-0009 Section 1).

headers_too_large.summary: The header section exceeds the listener's header bound

error.message: Text for people; not part of the contract.

500.description:
Internal Server Error. Error codes:

- `service`/`internal`: Any other failure inside the daemon (ADR-0008 Section 5).

internal.summary: Any other failure inside the daemon

error.message: Text for people; not part of the contract.

501.description:
Not Implemented. Error codes:

- `request`/`not_implemented`: The request uses a transfer coding the daemon does not implement (ADR-0009 Section 1).

not_implemented.summary: The request uses a transfer coding the daemon does not implement

error.message: Text for people; not part of the contract.

503.description: The daemon does not accept new Jobs. This body is the readiness object, not the error envelope (ADR-0008 Section 6).

JobId.name: job_id
JobId.description: The daemon-issued canonical lowercase UUIDv7. Any other text is `400` `invalid_job_id` (ADR-0008 Sections 1 and 5).

Job.description: A Job (ADR-0008 Section 3). Clients ignore fields they do not know.

state.description: The ADR-0002 Job state. Closed vocabulary.

outcome.description: Equal to `state` when `terminal` is `true`; `null` otherwise. Closed vocabulary.

jobs.description: Every resident Job, in creation order.

CreateJobRequest.description: Exactly one field. An unknown field, a missing field, or a wrong type is `422` `validation_failed` (ADR-0008 Section 5).

application_id.description: Names a deployment-registered Application. A deployment registers only `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:-]*`; a value of 1 to 128 characters that is not registered is `422` `job`/`unknown_application` whatever its characters (ADR-0008 Section 4, ADR-0009 Section 9).

CancelJobRequest.description: Only `{}`. Any other well-formed JSON is `422` `validation_failed` (ADR-0009 Section 10).

Readiness.description: The readiness object (ADR-0008 Section 6). `reasons` is empty exactly when `ready` is `true`.

ReadinessReason.description: One reason readiness is false. Codes and fields are additive (ADR-0008 Sections 2 and 6). The v1 codes: `unresolved_jobs` (with `job_ids`), `service_failed`, `shutting_down`.

job_ids.description: With `unresolved_jobs`: the replayed Jobs that are not resolved.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The error body of every error status, except the `503` of `GET /v1/ready` (ADR-0008 Section 5).

domain.description: Stable machine identifier. v1 uses `request`, `job`, and `service`.

code.description: Stable machine identifier. Codes are additive; a client classifies an unknown code by its status (ADR-0008 Section 2).

message.description: For people; not part of the contract.

details.description: `{}` in v1; fields may be added later (ADR-0009 Section 7).

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method Not Allowed: the route exists and does not list the method, including `HEAD` and `OPTIONS` (ADR-0008 Section 5, ADR-0009 Section 6).

method_not_allowed.summary: The method is not allowed for this resource

error.message: Text for people; not part of the contract.
